description:
Command the skies with Storm! 
In this Character Guide, we break down how to use her wind, lightning and aerial movement to control the fight from mid-to-long range.

Learn how her Tempest mechanic changes the direction and speed of her attacks, helping you pressure opponents from afar while staying out of danger. 
Watch now and unleash the elements in every match.
